crew.overview: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.
crew.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey

crew.overview: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger and Brigitte, in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.
crew.title: Ginger Snaps

details.biography: Grant Harvey is a Canadian film and television writer, producer and director.  Harvey is an actor and director known for his work in television and film. He began his acting career in the mid-2000s, appearing in television series such as CSI: NY and The Secret Life of the American Teenager. Harvey has also directed short films and episodes for television series, showcasing his versatility in the entertainment industry. His work is characterized by a strong screen presence and a commitment to storytelling.
details.name: Grant Harvey
